steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Production planning determines the most efficient sequence of manufacturing operations. | Key Fact: The plan lists every operation in order: material preparation, shaping, machining, finishing, assembly and inspection. | Key Fact: Process selection matches the manufacturing method to material, quantity, tolerance and geometry. | Key Fact: Jigs guide a cutting tool to the correct position (e.g. a drilling jig ensures identical hole positions).

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from production planning &amp; quality, and one past-paper question.
